title: Allegany-Limestone 8th Grade Trip 2027
subtitle: Allegany-Limestone 8th grade 2027 Washington, D.C. and Gettysburg may 13-15, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Allegany-Limestone 8th Grade. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & Evening Memorials Tour

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Boxed Sandwich Lunch
  • Visit the Steven F. Udar-Hazy Center
  • Group Exploration of the Smithsonian Museums
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (two nights)
 

Day 2: Arlington National Cemetery & George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery
  • Lunch
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture
  • Visit the George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 3: Library of Congress & Gettysburg Battlefield Tour

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Public Guided Tour of the United States Capitol Building
  • Visit the Library of Congress
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Guided Tour of the Gettysburg Battlefield with a Licensed Battlefield Guide
  • Admission to the Film, Cyclorama & Museum Experience in Gettysburg 
  • Dinner Allocation 
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Allegany-Limestone 8th Grade, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. and Gettysburg adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From national monuments to historic battlefields, this Washington, D.C. and Gettysburg experience is packed with meaningful moments! Students will tour the Udvar-Hazy Center, dive into the Smithsonian Museums, and pay tribute at the Lincoln, Korean War, Vietnam, and World War II Memorials. They'll walk through Arlington National Cemetery, explore the National Museum of African American History and Culture, and visit Mount Vernon Estate. A White House photo stop, time at the Jefferson, FDR, and MLK Memorials, and guided tours of the Capitol and Library of Congress round out the D.C. leg — before heading to Gettysburg for a licensed battlefield tour and an immersive Cyclorama and Museum experience.
